qa_pairs.question: What adjustments are necessary because of new bearings?
qa_pairs.answer: Friction torque of tapered roller bearings, backlash of ring gear, and tooth contact pattern adjustments are necessary because of new bearings.

qa_pairs.question: What three types of adjustments must be made when installing new bearings?
qa_pairs.answer: a) Friction torque of tapered roller bearings, b) Backlash of ring gear, c) Tooth contact pattern.
